name: enhancer of polycomb 1

function.text: EPC1 encodes enhancer of polycomb homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin-protein adaptor activity and enzyme-substrate adaptor activity. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and chromatin organization.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
